page_title: FUL 2-2 IPS | Fulham v Ipswich 05/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+8' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) receives a quality pass inside the box and fires a first-time shot. His effort towards the bottom right corner is saved by the goalkeeper.
90+7' Calvin Bassey (Fulham) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
90+5' A player from Fulham commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
90+5' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Andreas Pereira (Fulham). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
90+4' The ball is cleared after Raul Jimenez (Fulham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The linesman makes the right call and Fulham will have a corner.
90+3' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
90+1' 2 - 2 Goal! Raul Jimenez (Fulham) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Christian Walton into the top right corner.
90+1' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
90' Leif Davis (Ipswich) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Darren Bond signals. Penalty! A huge opportunity to score for Fulham.
89' Jack Clarke (Ipswich) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball onto the left post. Nice run, but unlucky finish!
88' A substitution has been made. Liam Delap goes off and Ali Al-Hamadi (Ipswich) comes on.

87' A cross by Antonee Robinson (Fulham) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ipswich.
87' He should have scored! Harry Wilson (Fulham) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
86' Harry Wilson (Fulham) takes the corner with a short pass.
86' Adama Traore (Fulham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Now Fulham have a corner.
84' Christian Walton leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Andreas Pereira (Fulham).
84' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Adama Traore (Fulham), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The referee blows his whistle, Fulham are awarded a corner kick.
83' Leif Davis (Ipswich) has a great chance to score from deep inside the box! He creates some space for the shot, but blazes it high over the crossbar. Very bad attempt.
82' Liam Delap (Ipswich) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Benjamin Johnson departs the field of play to be replaced by Wes Burns (Ipswich).
80' Kieran McKenna has decided to make a change. Jack Clarke (Ipswich) replaces Nathan Broadhead.
79' That's the end of the game for Sasa Lukic, who is replaced by Adama Traore (Fulham).

79' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes just wide of the left post.
78' Benjamin Johnson (Ipswich) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
77' One of the players from Ipswich times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
73' Kieran McKenna has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kalvin Phillips (Ipswich) replacing Jens Cajuste.
72' Substitution. Sammie Szmodics leaves the pitch and is replaced by Jack Taylor (Ipswich).
71' 1 - 2 GOAL! That’s a perfect strike from the spot by Liam Delap (Ipswich) into the top right hand corner, giving goalkeeper Bernd Leno no chance!
71' Liam Delap (Ipswich) is going to take the penalty!
70' Darren Bond blows his whistle after Timothy Castagne (Fulham) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. PENALTY to Ipswich! Let's see who will take responsibility.
69' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Raul Jimenez (Fulham) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Christian Walton no chance!
68' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
68' Samy Morsy (Ipswich) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
68' The Fulham players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
66' The referee shows a yellow card to Dara O'Shea (Ipswich). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.

66' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Fulham.
66' Harry Wilson (Fulham) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
64' Leif Davis (Ipswich) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

64' That was a nice football moment. Liam Delap (Ipswich) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the right post. Bernd Leno guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
63' Marco Silva prepares a substitution. Alex Iwobi is replaced by Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham).
63' Substitution. Andreas Pereira (Fulham) has come on for Tom Cairney.
63' What a wasted chance that is! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) who sends his header well wide of the left post.
63' Harry Wilson (Fulham) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
62' Darren Bond blows his whistle for a foul after Dara O'Shea (Ipswich) hacks down one of his opponents. Fulham are awarded the free kick.
59' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) turns on the edge of the box and immediately fires in a shot at goal, but the keeper can relax as it spins well wide of the left post.
58' Harry Wilson (Fulham) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
57' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Fulham have been awarded a corner kick.
55' Leif Davis (Ipswich) sends a cross in and finds Liam Delap inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.
54' Joachim Andersen (Fulham) sends a long cross over to Antonee Robinson, but Christian Walton comes forward to gather the ball.
53' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Christian Walton intercepts the ball.
53' Harry Wilson (Fulham) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
52' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Alex Iwobi (Fulham). Fulham win a corner.

48' Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
46' Half-time substitution. Issa Diop (Fulham) will not participate anymore and Emile Smith Rowe is coming on.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+1' Darren Bond has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Tom Cairney (Fulham). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
44' Harry Wilson (Fulham) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

44' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Harry Wilson (Fulham) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. Fulham will take a corner kick.
44' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

43' Harry Wilson (Fulham) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Fulham force a corner. They send men into the box.
42' Harry Wilson (Fulham) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
39' Nathan Broadhead (Ipswich) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
38' 0 - 1 Goal! Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Bernd Leno. He makes it 0:1.
38' Benjamin Johnson (Ipswich) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the bar.
36' Harry Wilson (Fulham) commits a foul and Darren Bond immediately signals a free kick.
33' Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
33' Leif Davis (Ipswich) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Corner kick. Ipswich will have an opportunity.
32' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Darren Bond blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
29' Joachim Andersen (Fulham) meets the free kick and unleashes a header from the edge of the box, but it's not powerful enough to trouble Christian Walton.
27' Leif Davis (Ipswich) can count himself lucky for not being sent off after only receiving a caution from the referee.
27' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Leif Davis (Ipswich). Darren Bond saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Fulham.
26' The total number of attempts is 4:0. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 1:0.
22' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
21' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.

20' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the bottom left corner. The effort, however, is blocked by Christian Walton, who pulls off a stunning save!
20' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) fails to deliver a cross from the free kick as his attempt is thwarted by the opposition's defence.

19' Jens Cajuste (Ipswich) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Darren Bond blows his whistle for an infringement. Free kick. Fulham will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
18' Liam Delap (Ipswich) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
13' Harry Wilson (Fulham) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

12' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Fulham force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
9' Leif Davis (Ipswich) attempts to find Sammie Szmodics, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
8' Darren Bond blows his whistle after Sasa Lukic (Fulham) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Ipswich win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
5' Tom Cairney (Fulham) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball goes out of play and Ipswich will have a goal kick.
4' Fulham hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Fulham will kick the game off.
Darren Bond was nominated as the referee for this game.
